entries.b2a5cda8e5e8a9d4: "ZAC" adopts "parameter design," in which functions needed across many industries are pre-installed as parameters, so user companies can build a system suited to their own operations without individual development. Parameters are continuously added and expanded in response to requests from user companies and others. In addition, the company has both business systems that strengthen a company's internal operations and marketing support that strengthens its external presence, a structure that enables it to comprehensively support companies' digital shift.

entries.de19cfcc379083ed: The company cites as its management philosophy becoming a company that provides greater "happiness and joy" to more people, and with "Technology × Creativity" as its slogan, it aims to become a global technology-oriented company. Through its two businesses, the Cloud Solutions Business, which supports the management efficiency of companies, and the Marketing Solutions Business, which can execute clients' marketing strategies, it says it will continue to support the growth of its client companies. In its company-wide strategy, it identifies three key issues, "business," "people" and "environment," and says it will work on solving social issues through its business, recruiting, developing and retaining people and promoting diversity, and reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
